title.narrative: HCFC Phase Out Management Plan (Stage II)

description.narrative: The HCFC Phase-out Management Plan for Serbia was approved in December 2010 at the 62nd Meeting of Executive Committee of the Multilateral Fund for the implementation of the Montreal Protocol. The project was approved in accordance with the Agreement between the Government and the Executive Committee for the period 2011 to 2020 to meet the 35 per cent reduction in HCFC consumption. The second phase aiming to achieve 67.5% reduction in 2025 will be prepared and submitted in 2019.
